carpet.rule.autoMending.name: Automatic Mending
carpet.rule.autoMending.desc: Automatically repairs one damaged Mending item per second (fully). Spends XP banked in the experience bar first, and draws from experience levels when the bar runs short; only stops once the player is out of XP entirely
carpet.rule.voidWarehouse.name: Void Warehouse
carpet.rule.voidWarehouse.desc: A crafting table renamed via anvil becomes a server-wide shared warehouse
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseRestock.name: Void Warehouse Restock
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseRestock.desc: Lets a printer that ran out of blocks while building take a full stack straight from the Void Warehouse. Warning: while enabled, any player with a compatible printer can draw from the shared stock
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseExchange.name: Void Warehouse 9-in-1 Exchange
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseExchange.desc: Lets an out-of-stock item be handed over by spending its 9-in-1 recipe ingredients: 1 iron ingot comes out of 9 iron nuggets, and 1 iron ingot can be broken out of an iron block with the change returned to the warehouse. Only kicks in when the item itself is out of stock, and only along recipes that really exist in vanilla (26.3: 29 edges over 53 items). Requires the Void Warehouse rule
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseCraft.name: Void Warehouse Recipe Crafting
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseCraft.desc: Lets an out-of-stock item be handed over by spending the ingredients of the recipe the player has actually crafted before: craft one piston by hand and from then on 4 cobblestone, 3 planks, 1 iron ingot and 1 redstone from the warehouse hand over a piston. Missing ingredients are crafted down through other learned recipes (up to 4 levels deep), the recipe book is shared server-wide, and a recipe is recorded the moment the result is taken from a crafting grid. Requires the Void Warehouse rule
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseBlockDrops.name: Void Warehouse Block Drops
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseBlockDrops.desc: Block drops from a block a player breaks go straight into the Void Warehouse instead of falling on the ground - they never enter the world and never enter the player's inventory. Only player-broken blocks count: explosion drops, mob drops and thrown items stay where they are, and experience orbs are untouched. If the warehouse cannot be read, drops fall normally and are never silently swallowed. Shulker boxes are unpacked exactly like hopper insertion (empty boxes are stored whole). Requires the Void Warehouse rule
carpet.rule.concretePowderToGlass.name: Smelt Concrete Powder Into Stained Glass
carpet.rule.concretePowderToGlass.desc: Lets a regular furnace smelt all 16 concrete powder colours into the matching stained glass (0.1 xp / 200 ticks, same as sand into glass). Only regular furnaces are affected; blast furnaces and smokers still reject concrete powder
